metadata.name: PluginInstrument
metadata.description: A VST3 or CLAP synth from elsewhere, played from the keyboard. Try: Choose an installed synth and play it. It takes every note itself rather than one per voice, because a hosted synth does its own polyphony — so voices on a NoteInput above it change nothing, and a filter after it filters the whole chord rather than each note. With no plugin chosen it stays silent, which is the node waiting rather than the patch being broken. Generated by tools/node-demos.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
